<div class="consulting-lead">
I connect the pieces: **raw data, cloud platforms, analysis pipelines, and AI models** become one working system your team can trust and reuse. I work between the scientists asking the questions and the engineers running the platforms. Specialty in **single-cell and antibody data**; the platform work applies to **any kind of data**. 10+ years across biotech, consulting, NIH, and FDA.
</div>

<div class="consulting-kicker">Four focused offerings</div>

::: {.consulting-grid}

::: {.consulting-card}
<div class="consulting-number">01 / DATA PLATFORMS</div>

### Cloud data platforms, end to end

Everything in one place, from raw files to dashboards, on Azure or AWS in your own account. Built for scientific data, and equally for business and operational data.

- **Raw, curated, and analytics-ready** layers, with quality checks between them
- **Azure Data Factory** or AWS services for orchestration, **Databricks**, SQL, and Python/R for transformation
- **Notebooks, BI dashboards, and internal tools** on top, plus HPC or cluster compute when a workload needs it
- Permissions, logging, and cost visibility

<div class="consulting-deliver"><strong>Deliverable:</strong> an architecture blueprint or working pilot, with cost and performance trade-offs, and a handover your team can run.</div>

<div class="consulting-bg"><strong>Background:</strong> cloud data platforms covering ingestion, security, and monitoring for NIH, FDA, and HHS missions; an AWS genomics workflow with analytics across 12,500+ datasets.</div>

<div class="consulting-tags"><span>Azure</span><span>AWS</span><span>Databricks</span><span>Data Factory</span><span>SQL</span><span>HPC</span></div>
:::

::: {.consulting-card}
<div class="consulting-number">02 / PIPELINES</div>

### Long, reproducible analysis pipelines

From raw data to results in a dozen or more steps: QC, processing, alignment, differential expression, pathway analysis. Documented, rerunnable, and handed over.

- **Single-cell** pipelines from raw reads to annotated, analysis-ready results
- **Antibody repertoire NGS**, including customized nf-core/airrflow
- **Nextflow or Snakemake** with containers and Python/R notebooks

<div class="consulting-deliver"><strong>Deliverable:</strong> a documented, runnable pipeline with handover and a short walkthrough for your team.</div>

<div class="consulting-bg"><strong>Background:</strong> bulk and single-cell RNA-seq pipelines at FDA; an antibody pipeline for 2B+ sequences (about 3 TB).</div>

<div class="consulting-tags"><span>Nextflow</span><span>Snakemake</span><span>Python</span><span>R</span><span>Containers</span></div>
:::

::: {.consulting-card}
<div class="consulting-number">03 / APPLIED AI</div>

### Applied AI: understand, run, adapt

Put existing models to work on your data, and adapt them to your datasets when it pays off. Not training new models from scratch.

- **Run inference at scale** with models such as protein language models (ESM-2), and interpret the results
- **Adapt an existing model** to a custom dataset, compared against transparent baselines
- **Held-out evaluation** with stated limitations, tracked in MLflow

<div class="consulting-deliver"><strong>Deliverable:</strong> a proof of concept, evaluation, and go/no-go recommendation. Outputs support research decisions; they do not replace experimental validation.</div>

<div class="consulting-bg"><strong>Background:</strong> zero-shot antibody fitness and developability inference with repeatable evaluation; model-ready antibody data for protein language models.</div>

<div class="consulting-tags"><span>PyTorch</span><span>TensorFlow</span><span>MLflow</span><span>Protein language models</span></div>
:::

::: {.consulting-card}
<div class="consulting-number">04 / CUSTOM ANALYSIS</div>

### Custom single-cell and antibody analysis

For the questions that standard workflows do not answer: tailored analyses built on established Python and R tools.

- **Single-cell** annotation, markers, and pathway analysis, adapted to your design
- **Antibody repertoire** parsing, annotation, and alignment
- Clear figures, tables, and a written summary of methods and findings

<div class="consulting-deliver"><strong>Deliverable:</strong> reproducible analysis code or notebooks, results, and a written methods summary.</div>

<div class="consulting-bg"><strong>Background:</strong> author of the open-source scPipeline (R, CRAN) and OAS-wrapper (Python, PyPI); 20+ peer-reviewed publications.</div>

<div class="consulting-tags"><span>Python</span><span>R</span><span>tidyverse</span><span>pandas</span><span>PyTorch</span></div>
:::

:::

## Short engagements

Need something smaller than a project? These are fixed-scope and short, with scope and price agreed up front, so you know the outcome before we start.

<div class="consulting-short">
<div><strong>Data platform blueprint</strong>I review where your data lives today and design the target setup on Azure or AWS: storage layers, orchestration, access, and cost.<span>Output: architecture diagram, short report, and a walkthrough call.</span></div>
<div><strong>Pipeline review</strong>I review your Nextflow or Snakemake workflow, or your analysis scripts, and return a written assessment: reproducibility gaps, risks, and a prioritized fix list.<span>Output: short report and a walkthrough call.</span></div>
<div><strong>Antibody data readiness sprint</strong>Raw antibody repertoire data, public or your own, turned into cleaned, annotated inputs ready for protein language models and downstream analysis.<span>Output: curated dataset, quality notes, and reusable code.</span></div>
<div><strong>Model evaluation review</strong>A review of how an ML model is tested on your data: metrics, held-out splits, data leakage, and stated limitations.<span>Output: findings and a go/no-go recommendation.</span></div>
</div>

<div class="consulting-note">

Short engagements work well as a first step: if they show value, they can lead into a pilot from the offerings above. Scope, timeline, and price are agreed in writing before work begins.

</div>

## Where I fit

<div class="consulting-fit">
<div><strong>A good fit</strong>
<ul>
<li>Data scattered across files, drives, or tools, and you want one trusted place</li>
<li>A multi-step pipeline that needs to be reproducible and handed over</li>
<li>Single-cell or antibody data that needs custom analysis</li>
<li>A question about whether an AI model can help with your data</li>
</ul></div>
<div><strong>Not a fit</strong>
<ul>
<li>Building custom software applications or websites</li>
<li>Training large models from scratch</li>
<li>Genomics-only or proteomics-only projects</li>
<li>Work involving patient-identifiable data shared outside your own secured environment</li>
</ul></div>
</div>
